comment: Verbatim in registry 907 description (local snapshot 2026-10-12); the same record's 'CEBAS Components' lists a 'Water loop' (pump ~24 L/h), which supports the water_loop category.
Verbatim in Paul et al. 2012 Methods (Europe PMC full text PMC3556330); same paragraph says the GIS occupies one of the two ERCs.
Verbatim in Massa et al. NTRS 20160006558 PDF p.3 (29.2 x 36.8 cm, 0.11 m2).
Verbatim in registry 1001 description (local snapshot): 50-70% RH, +/-7.5% about the setpoint.

SPLASH 64 background gives Shuttle middeck locker or ISS EXPRESS Rack but not 'EXPRESS Rack 2'. That detail comes from the note's source, Cox 2010 slides (NTRS 20110942664), which the auditor confirmed says 'ABRS Installed in EXPRESS Rack 2'.

Patent verbatim for the outer loop (fans 213 draw cabin air via the left-side air vent 216). 'Incubator-cabin exchange through a filtered port' is not in the patent. It is in OSDR registry 1001 (confirmed), which this record does not cite.
Found in NTRS 19960001911 PDF section 3.1.7 (PDF pp.17-18; only hyphenation and page-break differences). The report also gives the STS-40 / June 1991 flight of SLS-1.

Cited source says fluorinated polymer, transparent bellows, light cap and white walls behind/left. 'Teflon' is not in it. It comes from the note's source, Massa 2015 slides (NTRS 20150021302), which the auditor confirmed says 'Teflon Bellows'.
Verbatim in ICES-2015-081 PDF p.5 (TTU repository bitstream). The SRM is isolated from ISS air by a door seal, which supports 'sealed'.
Verbatim in Shiba 2017 (PMC5589811). The Fig.1 legend says 'The centrifuge accommodates six HCU' at one mouse per HCU, split 6 AG + 6 MG; 77 rpm gives 1 g.

Hwang 2023 (PMC10710480; vol 9, p.88 confirmed) supports CO2-independent medium, a 20 mL flush per chamber and exchange every other day. The label 'MVP2-Cell-03' is not in the paper, which says SPACEX-20. The auditor confirmed the label in OSDR registry payload MVP2-Cell-03 (SpaceX-20 iPSC-cardiomyocyte study).

OSD-961 protocol (snapshot) is verbatim for 8 loops x 3 FEP 25-mL bags. 'Lunchbox size' is not in the protocol. It comes from the Redwire 2021 newsroom post named in the note, which the auditor confirmed says 'two lunchbox size cassettes'.
Verbatim in Chatani 2015 Methods (PMC4585676). The JAXA AQH spec page also gives 3.2 L total.
Verbatim in registry 907 'Experiment Module' component: up to four compartments, one of them the microbial filter.
Verbatim in Massa et al. NTRS 20160006558 PDF p.6 (APH, 0.19 m2).

JAXA AQH spec table is verbatim. The page's 'AQH Water Flow Diagram' shows two aquarium branches, each with its own waste filter, flow sensor and pump, so 'in parallel' is supported. The note's 'branch geometry not published' is too cautious.
Verbatim in Riskowski et al. 2006 PDF p.10: 7.3 (g/h)/kg BW for BALB/c. Caveat: measured in conventional cages with bedding at 24 C, not in the HCU (the note says so).
Verbatim in Sakimura 1999 (J-STAGE PDF). The paper also places the heat exchanger in the Main Unit and says the Neurolab FP and water-loop parts were heat-insulated.

Shimbo 2016 (PMC4873486) only gives polycarbonate walls and floor. 'PulSheet' paper is in Shiba 2017 Suppl. Table 1 and the photocatalytic thermal spray is in the Shiba 2017 main text (both confirmed). Neither is cited for this record, and the note does not mention the spray.
Verbatim in Chatani 2015 Methods: 0.1 L/min per aquarium.
Verbatim in SPLASH 46 background (local snapshot).

Cancedda 2012 (PMC3362598) states 2 bars ~90 g total, 5 g/day, ~0.5 L tank refilled ~every 10 days, 7 mL/day. Bar dimensions come from Liu 2009 (Basic Appl Myol 19; confirmed), which gives ONE 149x73x7.5 mm bar of ~90 g per cage. That conflicts with '2 bars, ~90 g total' (~45 g/bar) and needs reconciling.
Shiba 2017 Suppl. Table 1 is verbatim (LED 50 lux, 12-12 h). IR illumination is not in that table; it is in the Shiba 2017 main text ('LED/IR video camera') and the JAXA MHU page named in the note.
SPLASH 36 (MVP) temperature_range = '14-40C' (local snapshot). This is facility capability, not a set point. SPLASH 46 (ADSEP) carries the identical string.
Verbatim in OSD-622 protocol (local snapshot). OSD-622 platform = BPS as flown on STS-110 (PESTO).

Registry 1057 is verbatim for two 600 mm rotors with 4 ECs each, and its version text says 'Each EC contained five seedling cassettes'. The 174/206 mm radii are not in the registry. They come from Herranz 2019 (PMC6889863; confirmed), which the note names.

Moyer 2016 (PMC5515519) is verbatim for 4.0 g + 4.5 mL per mouse per day and 40 g + 50 mL per rat per day. 'Slide-in' plates is not in Moyer (food plates attached to the water box or cage side). It is in OSDR registry 133 (confirmed).
Verbatim in registry 1379 Lighting component (local snapshot). The same text gives IR lights for dark-cycle viewing and a software-programmable cycle.
Verbatim in Shiba 2017 Suppl. Table 3 (HCU telemetry AG 22.8-23.8, MG 22.5-24). The value [22.5, 24.0] is the union of the on-orbit AG and MG ranges.

Registry 1380 is verbatim for powered launch and return on Dragon and non-rack ISS use. 'Middeck-locker' and 'Cygnus' are not in the registry. They come from Niederwieser ICES-2014-101 (confirmed: AEM-T and AEM-E each in a single middeck locker). That paper names Cygnus and Dragon only as carriers to upgrade (design intent).

OSD-961 protocol is verbatim (8 hatchlings per 25 mL FEP bag) and names V. fischeri strain ES114. The SPLASH list, which the value itself attributes to SPLASH, is confirmed in SPLASH 46 specimen_types_supported.

The NTRS 20020073543 PDF has no text layer. Tesseract OCR of printed p.150 (PDF p.162, NASDA water-quality attachment) matches verbatim. Printed p.149 defines g N/Ld as per litre of filter matrix per day.
The JAXA repository PDF is encrypted; text extracted with Ghostscript contains the quote verbatim (8 PEUs, STS-128). Curl with a Chrome user-agent got HTTP 406; the default curl user-agent worked.
Verbatim in the NASA Facts PDF (split across columns). It also says the VFB needs no power or data connectivity.
Verbatim in brochure p.12 'Specifications'. The same page has 'Membrane oxygenator using silicone elastomer tubing'.
Verbatim in Cancedda 2012. The ACS drives continuous airflow through the cages and exchanges ~5% with the cabin every 2 min.

PubMed gave curl and WebFetch a cookie wall; the abstract was read via Europe PMC (PMID 11537923) and is verbatim. '(1-2 mm)' comes from the note's NTRS 19990062734 (confirmed). The species epithet 'aurita' and 'moon jellyfish' appear in neither source (not checked).
Verbatim in NTRS 19940006708 PDF p.39 (OCR renders 'W/rat' as 'Wlrat'). 3.16 W/rat is the MAEM-SD mean. Caveat: measured in a mock AEM at standard density, not the RAHF (the note says so).
Verbatim in OSD-595 protocol (local snapshot; MVP-Fly-01). Continuous circulation of cabin air supports 'forced'. The Mhatre 2022 paper was not checked separately.
Verbatim in Land et al. (PMC10800490) for the Plant Signaling (PS) runs; PRR also used 21%. Minor: e-published 8 Jan 2024 in vol 14 (2023 collection) but cited as 2023.
